@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The government have made many new laws to prevent d______n in the workplace, whether it is based on gender, age, or religion.
= discrimination
~詞義 discrimination（n.）歧視
~原文 The government have made many new laws to prevent discrimination in the workplace, whether it is based on gender, age, or religion.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Tom was asked to e______e on his argument so the class could understand his reasoning more clearly.
= elaborate
~詞義 elaborate（v.）詳盡闡述
~原文 Tom was asked to elaborate on his argument so the class could understand his reasoning more clearly.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It takes Mr. Wang two hours to c______e between his house and office, and sometimes even longer if the traffic is heavy.
= commute
~詞義 commute（v.）通勤
~原文 It takes Mr. Wang two hours to commute between his house and office, and sometimes even longer if the traffic is heavy.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Drinking water that is c______ed by heavy metals may lead to serious health problems, such as skin diseases, infertility, or even cancer.
= contaminated
~詞義 contaminate（adj.）汙染
~原文 Drinking water that is contaminated by heavy metals may lead to serious health problems, such as skin diseases, infertility, or even cancer.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Ted is a successful a______t who has designed many skyscrapers and famous buildings that now stand in big cities around the world.
= architect
~詞義 architect（n.）建築師
~原文 Ted is a successful architect who has designed many skyscrapers and famous buildings that now stand in big cities around the world.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Hawaii is a popular tourist ______. In particular, many newlyweds like to go there for their honeymoon.
A: consumption
B: destination
C: execution
D: conviction
= B
~詞義 destination（n.）目的地
~原文 Hawaii is a popular tourist destination. In particular, many newlyweds like to go there for their honeymoon.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Wendy has decided to ______ her study room into a second bedroom so that there will be a place for her parents to sleep when they visit her.
A: depict
B: conceal
C: convert
D: exceed
= C
~詞義 convert（v.）改裝
~原文 Wendy has decided to convert her study room into a second bedroom so that there will be a place for her parents to sleep when they visit her.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Vegetables are rich in vitamins and ______. You should eat more vegetables to maintain a healthy diet.
A: fiber
B: distinction
C: extension
D: architecture
= A
~詞義 fiber（n.）纖維
~原文 Vegetables are rich in vitamins and fiber. You should eat more vegetables to maintain a healthy diet.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ part of the house looks ancient, but the inside of the building has been remodeled, so everything is new and comfortable.
A: corporate
B: distinctive
C: excessive
D: external
= D
~詞義 external（adj.）外部的
~原文 The external part of the house looks ancient, but the inside of the building has been remodeled, so everything is new and comfortable.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: When you sign any legal ______, be sure to read everything carefully to protect your rights.
A: conversion
B: commuter
C: executive
D: document
= D
~詞義 document（n.）文件
~原文 When you sign any legal document, be sure to read everything carefully to protect your rights.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: accord
B: contagious
C: contemporary
D: cognitive
E: distinctive
F: executive

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The artist used bold shapes and colors, giving his paintings a(n) ______ style that viewers would never forget.
= E
~詞義 distinctive（adj.）獨特的
~原文 The artist used bold shapes and colors, giving his paintings a(n) distinctive style that viewers would never forget.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Vivian prefers classical music to ______ music; she simply can't stand rock and pop music.
= C
~詞義 contemporary（adj.）當代的
~原文 Vivian prefers classical music to contemporary music; she simply can't stand rock and pop music.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: ______ positions require not only experience but also strong communication and problem-solving skills.
= F
~詞義 executive（adj.）經營管理的;有權執行決策的
~原文 Executive positions require not only experience but also strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The disease is highly ______. In order to stop it from spreading, the government is urging people to get vaccinated.
= B
~詞義 contagious（adj.）(疾病)傳染的
~原文 The disease is highly contagious. In order to stop it from spreading, the government is urging people to get vaccinated.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Jason is an honorable businessperson; everything he does is in ______ with the law, and he never cheats his clients.
= A
~詞義 accord（n.）(與…)一致
~原文 Jason is an honorable businessperson; everything he does is in accord with the law, and he never cheats his clients.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: altered
B: characterized
C: capability
D: corporate
E: extensive
F: conformed

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Protecting public resources should be treated as a(n) ______ responsibility in every community.
= D
~詞義 corporate（adj.）全體的
~原文 Protecting public resources should be treated as a(n) corporate responsibility in every community.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Leo did ______ research on the features and prices of different cars before he finally bought one.
= E
~詞義 extensive（adj.）廣泛的
~原文 Leo did extensive research on the features and prices of different cars before he finally bought one.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: We ______ our travel plans at the last minute because a big typhoon is coming. We will just stay at the hotel and do some shopping.
= A
~詞義 alter（v.）改變
~原文 We altered our travel plans at the last minute because a big typhoon is coming. We will just stay at the hotel and do some shopping.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Roger's parents always believed that he had the ______ to achieve great success in music, and sure enough, he is now a world-renowned pianist.
= C
~詞義 capability（n.）能力
~原文 Roger's parents always believed that he had the capability to achieve great success in music, and sure enough, he is now a world-renowned pianist.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The director's movies are ______ by a dark sense of humor and surprising plot twists.
= B
~詞義 characterize（v.）具有…的特徵
~原文 The director's movies are characterized by a dark sense of humor and surprising plot twists.
